name: session-status
description: Model and effort, the context window as a bar, and subscription usage under the prompt

display.title: What the subscription meter shows
display.description: rotate: one window at a time, switching every few seconds. both: the 5-hour and weekly windows side by side. session: only the 5-hour window. week: only the weekly window. When only one window is reported, it shows that one whatever the choice.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long the meter shows each window (5-hour, weekly) before it switches to the other. Only used when display is rotate.
